claim: The mouse reaches the engine through the window procedure, not DirectInput: the game creates a DirectInput keyboard device only (GUID_SysKeyboard; no GUID_SysMouse device in the front end, a campaign or a battle), so the RmlUi host routes the mouse in its window subclass and DirectInput arbitration only matters for the keyboard. Synthetic WM_MOUSEMOVE/WM_*BUTTON*/WM_MOUSEWHEEL sent to the window take the same route
notes: ctl ui state input_paths (di_mouse false, di_keyboard true) in every cell; proxy.log 'ui: DirectInput keyboard device'
